OBJECT Report 50105 Feuille de tournee
{
  OBJECT-PROPERTIES
  {
    Date=12.02.20;
    Time=14:30:00;
    Modified=Yes;
    Version List=MED1.00;
  }
  PROPERTIES
  {
    OnPreReport=VAR
                  i@1000 : Integer;
                BEGIN
                  IF ISSERVICETIER THEN
                    ExportPath := ENVIRON('TEMP');
                  TempLine.DELETEALL;
                END;

  }
  DATASET
  {
    { 1   ;    ;DataItem;Tournee             ;
               DataItemTable=Table50010;
               DataItemTableView=SORTING(No.) WHERE(Status=CONST(Released));
               ReqFilterFields=No.;
               OnAfterGetRecord=BEGIN
                                  TempLine.RESET;
                                  TempLine.DELETEALL;
                                  BuildLines;
                                END;
                                 }

    { 2   ;1   ;Column  ;Tournee_No          ;
               SourceExpr="No." }

    { 3   ;1   ;Column  ;Tournee_Vehicule    ;
               SourceExpr=Vehicule }

    { 4   ;1   ;DataItem;LoopLines           ;
               DataItemTable=Table2000000026;
               DataItemTableView=SORTING(Number);
               OnPreDataItem=BEGIN
                               SETRANGE(Number,1,TempLine.COUNT);
                             END;

               OnAfterGetRecord=BEGIN
                                  IF Number = 1 THEN
                                    TempLine.FINDSET
                                  ELSE
                                    TempLine.NEXT;
                                  MontantLigne := TempLine.Amount;
                                  IF TempLine."Fixed Fee" THEN
                                    MontantLigne := MontantLigne + Tournee."Frais fixe";
                                  TotalMontant := TotalMontant + MontantLigne;
                                END;
                                 }

    { 5   ;2   ;Column  ;Line_CustomerNo     ;
               SourceExpr=TempLine."Customer No." }

    { 6   ;2   ;Column  ;Line_Amount         ;
               SourceExpr=MontantLigne }

    { 7   ;2   ;Column  ;FraisFixe           ;
               SourceExpr=Tournee."Frais fixe" }

    { 8   ;2   ;Column  ;Line_Weight         ;
               SourceExpr=TempLine.Weight }

  }
  REQUESTPAGE
  {
    PROPERTIES
    {
    }
    CONTROLS
    {
    }
  }
  LABELS
  {
    { 1   ;TitleLbl            ;CaptionML=[ENU=Route sheet;FRA=Feuille de tournee] }
  }
  CODE
  {
    VAR
      TempLine@1000 : TEMPORARY Record 50011;
      MontantLigne@1001 : Decimal;
      TotalMontant@1002 : Decimal;
      ExportPath@1003 : Text[250];
      ExportFile@1004 : File;
      XmlDoc@1005 : DotNet "'System.Xml, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b77a5c561934e089'.System.Xml.XmlDocument";
      TourneeMgt@1006 : Codeunit 50005;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE BuildLines@1();
    VAR
      SalesLine@1000 : Record 37;
    BEGIN
      SalesLine.SETRANGE("Tournee No.",Tournee."No.");
      IF SalesLine.FINDSET THEN
        REPEAT
          TempLine.INIT;
          TempLine."Customer No." := SalesLine."Sell-to Customer No.";
          TempLine.Amount := SalesLine.Amount;
          TempLine.Weight := SalesLine."Net Weight" * SalesLine.Quantity;
          TempLine.INSERT;
        UNTIL SalesLine.NEXT = 0;
    END;

    PROCEDURE ExportXml@2();
    BEGIN
      XmlDoc := XmlDoc.XmlDocument;
      ExportFile.CREATE(ExportPath + '\tournee.xml');
      ExportFile.CLOSE;
    END;

    BEGIN
    END.
  }
  RDLDATA
  {
    <?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<Report xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/sqlserver/reporting/2010/01/reportdefinition">
  <DataSets>
    <DataSet Name="DataSet_Result">
      <Fields>
        <Field Name="Tournee_No"><DataField>Tournee_No</DataField></Field>
        <Field Name="Tournee_Vehicule"><DataField>Tournee_Vehicule</DataField></Field>
        <Field Name="Line_CustomerNo"><DataField>Line_CustomerNo</DataField></Field>
        <Field Name="Line_Amount"><DataField>Line_Amount</DataField></Field>
        <Field Name="Line_AmountFormat"><DataField>Line_AmountFormat</DataField></Field>
        <Field Name="FraisFixe"><DataField>FraisFixe</DataField></Field>
        <Field Name="Line_Zone"><DataField>Line_Zone</DataField></Field>
      </Fields>
    </DataSet>
  </DataSets>
  <Body>
    <ReportItems>
      <Tablix Name="Lines">
        <TablixRowHierarchy><TablixMembers><TablixMember><Group Name="Vehicule"><GroupExpressions><GroupExpression>=Fields!Tournee_Vehicule.Value</GroupExpression></GroupExpressions></Group></TablixMember></TablixMembers></TablixRowHierarchy>
        <TablixBody><TablixRows><TablixRow><TablixCells>
          <TablixCell><CellContents><Textbox Name="Cust"><Paragraphs><Paragraph><TextRuns><TextRun><Value>=Fields!Line_CustomerNo.Value</Value></TextRun></TextRuns></Paragraph></Paragraphs></Textbox></CellContents></TablixCell>
          <TablixCell><CellContents><Textbox Name="Amt"><Paragraphs><Paragraph><TextRuns><TextRun><Value>=Sum(Fields!Line_Amount.Value) + Fields!LineTotal.Value</Value></TextRun></TextRuns></Paragraph></Paragraphs></Textbox></CellContents></TablixCell>
        </TablixCells></TablixRow></TablixRows></TablixBody>
      </Tablix>
    </ReportItems>
  </Body>
  <Page>
    <PageHeader><ReportItems><Textbox Name="T"><Paragraphs><Paragraph><TextRuns><TextRun><Value>=Parameters!TitleLbl.Value</Value></TextRun></TextRuns></Paragraph></Paragraphs></Textbox></ReportItems></PageHeader>
  </Page>
</Report>
    END_OF_RDLDATA
  }
}
